name: Control Island
description: A small floating island of controls that opens into a panel of options when one of them is chosen.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; options: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]; defaultValue?: string; value?: string; onChange?: (value: string) => void }[]
props.description: The triggers in the pill, each with the options its panel lists. Use value and onChange to control an item, or defaultValue to leave it uncontrolled.

props.name: position
props.description: The edge it is pinned to. The panel grows away from that edge.

props.name: align
props.description: Where along the edge it sits.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Morph back into the pill once an option is chosen.

props.name: showSelectedValue
props.description: Show each item's chosen option after its label, in a muted tone. Below 640 pixels the label is then kept for screen readers only.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the edge, and the minimum gap at the sides.

props.name: contained
props.description: Position against the nearest positioned parent instead of the window.

props.name: onItemChange
props.description: Called with an item's id when its panel opens, and with null when the panel closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the positioning wrapper. Also accepts every other div attribute.
